written_before: V2 REAL results (SEL1_REAL not started when written)
members: the run's HOF.json in order (A-half t_dd high to low), re-scored with its own combo on the A months; greedy: joins when its A monthly cost0 Pearson corr is <= 0.7 with every chosen member (constant series = no evidence = allowed); at most 20; t_A 0 or invalid skipped
composite: per signal hour, over the coins where each member is finite: average rank, demeaned, / std (ddof 0); sum of sign(t_A_j) * z_j, equal weight; a member not finite adds 0; no member finite -> not selectable
book: K 5, beta hedge, the chain's book; combo = best of the 60 by A-half t_dd (dd_max of the run), ties to the first in sel1_sweep.COMBOS order; then A + B once with that combo
null: T_combo_null = composite book t_B of the NULL hall through the same flow

gates.g3: A and B cost0 bp/day > 0 after removing the most favourable 1 % holding spells of each half (sel1_round.trimmed)
gates.g4: at most one calendar year (A + B months summed) of the opposite sign to t_B

selfcheck: V2 PC hall (SEL1_PC): a member with |B-hour Spearman corr| > 0.7 with the plant formula, and composite t_B >= 2
